title: BioQA-tail calibration at 300M, 520M and 1.2B
status: registered before any run of this extension; see REGISTRATION_4SCALE.json for the timestamp and SHA256
request: User task list of 2026-11-21, item 4: first report the model scale of the existing runs, then run the remaining scales: three initialisations (from scratch, AdamW source, Muon source), three learning rates per initialisation and optimizer about 3x apart, 10,000 steps of 128 sequences, evaluation at 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 steps, selection rule unchanged.

existing_version.design: DESIGN_BIOQA.md with its addendum of 2026-10-27; results BQ_RESULTS.json (18 runs)
existing_version.model_scale_of_the_existing_runs: 130M. Read from the run configuration: the queue passes the 130M source manifest to every run, the fine-tuned runs load adamw_130m_4 / muon_130m_4, and the from-scratch runs are randomly initialised from the configuration of adamw_130m_4.

protocol_identical_to_130m.data: the frozen BioQA-tail data (m = 12: 4096 persons in groups g = 0..12, six QA pairs per person, 172,032 QA occurrences per epoch)
protocol_identical_to_130m.training: 10,000 steps, batch 128, warmup 200, cosine decay to 0.1 of the peak, gradient clipping 1.0, weight decay 0, tf32, loss on the answer tokens and EOS; hidden matrices by Muon or AdamW at the peak learning rate, embeddings, norms and head by AdamW at the auxiliary learning rate (scratch 1e-3, fine-tuning 3e-5), identical for both optimizers; seed 20261027
protocol_identical_to_130m.evaluation: steps 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000 on up to 128 persons per group x 6 attributes: first-token accuracy (FTA) and exact value accuracy per frequency group
protocol_identical_to_130m.from_scratch_model: random initialisation from the configuration of adamw_<scale>_4 (the architecture of that scale)

learning_rates.rule: three values 3x apart per initialisation and optimizer. Fine-tuned runs: centred on the VarTrace main-experiment learning rate of that scale, source and optimizer (the centre of the 130M grids was the 130M VarTrace value). From scratch: the 130M grid at every scale (no pretraining reference exists; if the best value is at an end of the grid this is reported, the grid is not extended).

selection_and_reading_unchanged.selection: per initialisation and optimizer, the learning rate with the highest mean-over-groups FTA at 10,000 steps; if several are within 0.5 points of the best, the one with the highest log-step AUC of mean-over-groups FTA; if still tied, the smaller learning rate. All learning rates are reported.
selection_and_reading_unchanged.primary: at the selected learning rates, per initialisation: Muon's FTA on the three rarest groups minus AdamW's. Replicates the tail advantage if >= 10 points; no tail advantage if within +-3 points; otherwise in between.
selection_and_reading_unchanged.secondary: S1 tail-3 mean FTA difference at 2,000 and 5,000 steps; S2 log-step AUC of tail-3 mean FTA over the five evaluation points; S3 first evaluation step with tail-3 mean FTA >= 0.9. Same thresholds as the primary reading.
selection_and_reading_unchanged.intervals: normal approximation with 128 persons per group as the sample size, unpaired, as in the 130M addendum

outputs.result_file: BQ_RESULTS.json with the existing structure (runs, selected, comparisons), one per scale, with the scale stated in the file and in the keys ('<scale>/A/adamw', ...)
outputs.package: MuonPaperData_<date>_BIOQA_<scale>.zip: result JSON, per-run results at every evaluation step, training logs, learning rates, analysis scripts, this file, SHA256 list. No user, institution or host name in paths or contents.

execution.gpu_rule: idle GPUs only, one run per GPU
execution.weights: the trainer writes no model files; nothing to keep or delete
